content: ॠ {%ind.%} An interjection of (1) terror; (2) warding off; (3) reproach or censure; (4) compassion; (5) remembrance; (6) Commencement of speech; (7) protection; (8) pride; (9) looking up. --{%m.%} ({@ॠः@}) .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Bhairava. .²2 A Dānava or demon. --{%f.%} .²1 The mother of the gods; also of the demons. .²2 Recollection. .²3 Motion, going. --{%n.%} The breast. (<ab>cf.</ab> also ॠर्निषेधो भवः पूषा वरुणोऽमरराडजः . करी तरुर्नरः पाप्मा विद्वानथ रमापतिः .. <ls>Enm.</ls>)
